item.tib: phur pa'i rgyud bskang byin rlabs char 'bebs
item.coloph: zab cing rgya che sngags lam rgya mtsho las/ bdud srin sgrol byed drag po dbal phur bon/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor g.yo 'khrug rba rlabs rdzogs/ lung rig tshad gsum gru gzings legs spyod nas/ mtho ris mgon po'i rgyud bskang (skong) nor bu blangs/ rim gnyis byin rlabs dgos 'dod 'byung phyir yin/ rgyud dang sgrab thabs dbang khrid rnam thar dang / rgyud dbang rgyab yig rgyud bskang (skong) la sogs las/ gos ser bung ba'i (bas) pad mo'i bcud bsdud ltar/ dgongs pa'i bcud phyung gong 'og tshig bsdebs pa/ rgyud pa'i bka' drin rjes dran blo yis bskul/ bsam sbyor dag pa'i yi ger (mchan mnga' ris bsod nams rgyal mtshan) bkod pa la/ nyes par gyur srid rgyud pa'i bla ma dang / dbal phur lha tshogs bstan srung gnyan la bshags/ smra seng mkhas pa rnams la bzod gsol bzhes/ rgyud skong byin rlabs dngos grub char 'bebs 'di/ mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par shog/
